summary: Packaging heat seals failing on packaging line 2 causing seal rupture during transport
rootCauses: Thermocouple calibration drift on sealing bar #2 causing 12°C drop below minimum bonding temperature under continuous high-speed cycling.
solutions: Dual-sensor redundant thermocouple installation and automated PLC temperature interlock halting feed if bar temp drops below 150°C.

summary: Order fulfillment dispatch SLA delays exceeding 45 minutes during afternoon peak batch release
rootCauses: Pick cart replenishment congestion in aisle 4 due to overlapping wave-release schedules and lack of dynamic pathing.
solutions: Staggered 15-minute replenishment intervals and dynamic pick-path routing separating fast-moving inventory.

summary: Inconsistent raw resin viscosity causing injection molding nozzle clogging and barrel pressure spikes
rootCauses: Secondary supplier unblended regrind batch exceeding 8% moisture content without certified desiccating hopper pre-treatment.
solutions: In-line moisture sensor rejection gate and mandatory Certificate of Analysis (CoA) moisture limit clause on supplier PO.

summary: Conveyor drive motor intermittent thermal trip-outs on sorting sorter belt during shift handover
rootCauses: V-belt over-tensioning combined with bearing grease breakdown from incompatible synthetic lithium grease mix.
solutions: Laser belt tension alignment protocol and standardized single-spec polyurea lubricant grease guns with lockout tags.

summary: Warehouse AGV robotic carts stopping unexpectedly at junction 3
rootCauses: Optical LiDAR sensor lens dust buildup from high-velocity overhead HVAC circulation.
solutions: Weekly lens cleaning regimen and directional HVAC baffle installation.
